Subject: Request: commercial exception memo & CFO sign-off — Brightlane pilot (BL-2026-183)

Team,

Following a customer request (Brightlane Health, deal BL-2026-183), procurement is asking for an exception: 40% off list for a 12-month pilot (estimated 30M tokens/month). Customer prefers a narrow SLA (48h non-critical response) during the pilot. They want a commercial exception memo for CFO sign-off on their side; procurement indicated any discount >25% requires this.

Why I’m asking for an exception:
- Strategic: Brightlane is a reference target in healthcare verticals (HIPAA-adjacent workflows); a successful pilot buys us a case study and likely expansion into patient-facing features.
- Product fit: They tested in our hosted environment and validated latency/cost tradeoff; early telemetry looks promising.

Requested approvals and rationale I need from each of you:
- Aditya (Sales): Recommend approval if we can gate usage and include clear KPIs and a renewal pricing ladder. Proposed guardrails: token cap of 40M/month during pilot, automatic rate-limits if bursts exceed forecast, and a mandatory evaluation checkpoint at month 3.
- Laura (Finance): Need an indicative P&L impact (run-rate reduction vs LTV) and any XCM (cross-charge) concerns for Dedicated capacity if they request dedicated later. I attached a pricing model and a short memo (commercial_exception_memo-BL-2026-183.pdf + pricing_model_BL-2026-183.xlsx).
- Vivek (VP): I’ll need VP or CFO sign-off given the magnitude (>25%). If approved, we will provide a one-time commercial exception memo and updated SOW for signature.

Attachments: commercial_exception_memo-BL-2026-183.pdf (memo outlining discount, guardrails, and expiry), pricing_model_BL-2026-183.xlsx (sensitivity model). Also linking the HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.company.com/deals/BL-2026-183

Target timeline: internal sign-off by Thu 14 May so customer can finalize procurement; Brightlane is aiming to start the pilot mid-June.

Let me know questions — I can hop on a quick 20-min sync if helpful.

Thanks,
Jasmine
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: Request: commercial exception memo & CFO sign-off — Brightlane pilot (BL-2026-183)

Thanks for the packet, Jasmine. Quick clarifying questions before I run numbers: 
1) Is the 30M tokens/month a hard commit or an estimate for billing? If they underdeliver, do we bill the committed minimum?
2) Do we expect this to require Dedicated capacity in the 12-month window (that materially changes cost basis)?
3) Confirm whether the requested 40% discount is off list for hosted API only or also for any dedicated/reserved capacity add-ons.

If you can confirm the above, I’ll run a P&L impact and propose an approvable discount threshold (finance comfortable band) and whether this should be a one-time credit vs recurring list reduction.

- Laura

Jasmine / team —

I reviewed the memo and the revenue sensitivity. Approve a one-time commercial exception up to 40% off list for the 12-month pilot under the following conditions: 
1) Token cap of 40M/month hard cap; overage invoiced at list rates (no retroactive discounts).
2) 3-month formal review with a decision gate for renewal pricing — if KPIs (latency SLA, error rate, and usage variability) are met, we will negotiate standard renewal pricing; if not, pilot terminates.
3) Pilot will use hosted inference only; any move to Dedicated requires a new commercial review.
4) We issue the commercial exception memo and a one-time credit schedule tied to signed SOW. Finance to confirm final wording on credits (Laura).

Laura — please finalize the P&L language and confirm whether this should be recorded as a one-time contra-revenue credit or amortized. Once Laura confirms, I will sign the memo and Jasmine can send to Brightlane.
